prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: editable terrain/background master for the original Heroes of Might and Magic III additional ZAUN town, final native 800x374. INPUT IMAGE 1 is the EDIT TARGET, our own existing EMPTY buildable town terrain. Preserve the SAME wide panoramic framing, low frontal camera, perspective, three terrace shapes/heights/steps, empty walkable building plots, right-edge canal and dockable shore. Keep all foreground and middle terraces EMPTY of functional buildings so separately rendered construction layers can be added. Do not bake a town or interactable building into this background.
CHANGE: make this visibly ZAUN CHEMTECH with a chempunk industrial atmosphere rather than plain brown steampunk. Strong luminous toxic/neon CHEMICAL GREEN is the signature light: green reagent flowing visibly in narrow embedded utility conduits along terrace retaining walls and street gutters; thick patched pressure pipes on distant cliffs with small green glass inspection windows; green chemical haze and green reflected streaks in canal/wet stone. Add complementary bruised PURPLE/lavender-violet atmospheric depth and a few purple reagent-glass accents in distant infrastructure. Keep warm BROWN leather-like tarred timber, rust, weathered brick, wet ochre paving and oxidized copper as substantial solid material colors. Little amber only at actual furnaces. The chemical green should be clearly visible at native size, not a barely detectable desaturated hint. Color comes from physical lit fluids, glass and chemical vapor, NOT a uniform hue filter or drawn neon outlines.
LIGHT/STYLE: late-1990s original Heroes III richly textured painted/pre-rendered strategy-town scenery. Top-left broad cool lighting remains; green local emission modestly illuminates neighboring stone/metal. Deep readable dark brown/purple shadow, material texture and atmospheric depth. No global green wash. A bold chemtech green-purple-brown identity, yet readable foreground terrain for actual game sprites. No modern city, LED billboards, text, HUD, holograms, lens flare, flat neon vector lines, glossy mobile3D, anime, giant luminous shapes, people or creatures. Existing independent project-fiction industrial geography stays; do not claim a canonical map. Keep the complete same panoramic scene and all usable space. Opaque full painted background, no border or labels.
